files.name: NLP_monthly_fake_data.csv
files.row_meaning: One patient, calendar month, year, and NLP concept count.

columns.name: patientnum
columns.meaning: Patient identifier. Same meaning as PatientNum in the other files. 患者编号。
columns.demo_rule: Generated integers from -900200 to -900001. These are demo IDs, not copied source identifiers.

columns.name: month
columns.meaning: Calendar month of the occurrences. 发生月份。

columns.name: year
columns.meaning: Calendar year of the occurrences. 发生年份。
columns.demo_rule: 1995–2025, chosen for demonstration; not the confirmed source date range.

columns.name: cui
columns.meaning: NLP concept identifier. The inspected source includes AB-prefixed acronym concepts. NLP概念编号，也可包含AB开头的缩写概念。
columns.demo_rule: Generated C-plus-seven-digit codes and AB-prefixed acronym examples. Meanings and validity are not asserted.

columns.name: N
columns.meaning: Number of occurrences of this code or concept for this patient in this calendar month. 该患者该月该代码或概念的出现次数。
columns.demo_rule: Generated positive integer 1–20. 75% of draws use 1–3, otherwise 4–20. Demonstration probabilities only.

files.name: combined_daily_fake_data.csv
files.row_meaning: One daily local-code occurrence. Each row contributes a count of 1; there is no N column.

columns.name: PatientNum
columns.meaning: Patient identifier. Same meaning as patientnum in the NLP file. 患者编号。
columns.demo_rule: Generated integers from -900200 to -900001. These are demo IDs, not copied source identifiers.

columns.name: Start_date
columns.meaning: Date of the daily code occurrence. 每日代码记录对应的日期。
columns.demo_rule: Synthetic Date values represented as YYYY-MM-DD in CSV. The R conversion restores Date class.

columns.name: Local_Code
columns.meaning: Local code before grouping. 汇总到Group_Code之前的本地代码。
columns.demo_rule: Generated numeric-looking strings. Read as character, matching the inspected R class.

columns.name: Local_Code_Description
columns.meaning: Description associated with Local_Code. 本地代码的文字说明。
columns.demo_rule: Synthetic text tied consistently to its demo Local_Code. No real code-description pair was copied.

columns.name: Type
columns.meaning: Record category. The inspected preview shows Diagnosis. 记录类型，预览中出现Diagnosis。
columns.demo_rule: Diagnosis, Medication, Lab, Procedure are demo categories. The full source category list has not been verified.

files.name: Daily_codified_fake_data.csv
files.row_meaning: One daily group-code occurrence. Each row contributes a count of 1; there is no N column.

columns.name: PatientNum
columns.meaning: Patient identifier. Same meaning as patientnum in the NLP file. 患者编号。
columns.demo_rule: Generated integers from -900200 to -900001. These are demo IDs, not copied source identifiers.

columns.name: Start_date
columns.meaning: Date of the daily code occurrence. 每日代码记录对应的日期。
columns.demo_rule: Synthetic Date values represented as YYYY-MM-DD in CSV. The R conversion restores Date class.

columns.name: Group_Code
columns.meaning: Code after grouping or rollup. May be missing. 分组或汇总后的代码，可缺失。
columns.demo_rule: Generated PheCode, CCS, RXNORM and ungrouped-format examples. Approximately 3% missing by demo assumption. Source monthly preview confirms missing values can occur; daily missingness is assumed.
